title: Accessibility Guardian
text: VS Code extension project tied to EchoCoreLabs. Local-first static analysis for accessibility and privacy/compliance, including ADA/WCAG, HIPAA risk signaling, GDPR/PIPEDA/APP concepts. Architecture references include src/extension.ts, diagnostics runner, rules, analyzers, utilities, commands, activation configuration, esbuild, and vsce. Positioning emphasizes local-first, actionable findings, security-first workflow, and practical dev-tool scanning.
